title: Secondhand Bookshop Inventory Database Update
originalRequest: Add support for tracking physical book conditions in the stock management database.
latestMessage: Add support for tracking physical book conditions in the stock management database.

steps.title: Database migration for book condition tracking
steps.instruction: Develop and apply a database migration script that adds a 'condition_rating' enum column to the inventory table.
steps.acceptance: The migration applies to the local PostgreSQL instance successfully, updating the schema to support book conditions without losing existing inventory records.
steps.result: The migration script is blocked. During the dry-run, I encountered legacy records in the active inventory table with non-standard status values that cannot be cast to the new 'condition_rating' ENUM type. I am blocked until we establish a clear mapping for these anomalous legacy entries or receive a database cleanup script to run beforehand.
